note: What a server sends about a unit's health bar. The header names the unit.

bits.name: show
bits.note: Set to show the bar, clear to hide it. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: changeType
bits.note: Set where the bar's type changes; a client reads the type and side below only then. Clear in everything observed.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: barType
fields.note: Which sort of bar, read only where changeType is set and side is the client's player's side or zero: 1 a unit's, 2 a champion's; any other value only makes sure the unit has a bar. A server observed sends it either way, 49 in everything observed.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side that sees the change, or 0 for every side.
